items.t: Extreme weather drastically cuts Polk County farmers' citrus yield
items.x: Florida farmers are facing a difficult harvest season after a year of extreme weather, and one Polk County citrus farm says its crop yield is down about 50%.

items.t: South Florida Avenue Reconstruction Expected to Take More Than 3 Years
items.x: Lakeland’s $26.3 million project will bring wider sidewalks, improved crossings and a permanent three-lane design to Dixieland.

items.t: Lakeland man pleads guilty to shooting innocent horse over money: SAO
items.x: A Lakeland man is heading to prison after he shot an innocent horse when he didn't get the money he demanded for work, the Hillsborough County State Attorney's Office, 13th Judicial Circuit announced.

items.t: Grady Judd, public safety leaders raise emergency service concerns about Amendment 3: 'We're here warning you'
items.x: Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd, police chiefs, fire chiefs and firefighters gathered in Tampa on Monday to warn that Amendment 3, a proposed property tax amendment, could strain local government budgets and make it harder to maintain…

items.t: More Voting Myths, Debunked
items.x: Early voting begins Oct. 19, in Polk County. In part three of our series demystifying and debunking myths and misinformation about Florida elections, we're tackling the truth about vote by mail and polling places.

items.t: LPD Hosts National Prescription Drug Take Back Day Saturday
items.x: From 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. on Oct. 24, the Lakeland Police Department will host a drive-through drop-off for unwanted, unneeded, or expired medication.

items.t: Registration for LPD’s Cops for Kids Begins Oct. 26 and 27
items.x: The program has provided Christmas gifts and nurtured positive relationships with thousands of Lakeland children since it began in 2007.

items.t: Polk Disables Public Comments on County-Run Social Media Accounts
items.x: On Tuesday, Oct. 20, Polk County commissioners reached a unanimous vote to disable comments on all 21 county-run social media accounts, a decision that county officials say will curb misinformation and cut down on vulgarity.

items.t: More Than Candy: Why Lakeland Churches Go Big on Fall Festivals
items.x: From sensory-friendly activities to massive trunk-or-treats, Lakeland churches offer family fun while building community connections.

items.t: Polk Supervisor of Elections Debunks Social Media Ballot Rumors
items.x: LkldNow asks Melony Bell about social media claims that ballots might be rejected if written on by poll workers.

items.t: FL Poly Police Launch Aircraft Designed for Rescue Ops and Student Learning
items.x: On Tuesday, Oct. 20, the Florida Polytechnic University Police Department unveiled what it described as the first police aircraft of its kind in the country.

items.t: Lowe’s Insourcing of Plant City Warehouse Impacts 178 Saddle Creek Jobs
items.x: Lowe’s plans to bring Plant City warehouse operations in-house, ending Saddle Creek’s role and putting 178 positions in transition.

items.t: What Florida Voters Need to Know About Amendments 1 and 2
items.x: Florida voters get to decide whether to increase the state's rainy-day fund and exempt tractors and more from farmers' property taxes in this year's midterms.

items.t: Rays stun Brewers with 2-run rally in 12th inning and force World Series Game 5 with 4-3 win
items.x: Milwaukee was three outs from its first World Series title when Junior Camerino started the bottom of the 12th inning with a grounder to third. Thousands of Brewers fans who trekked to Tropicana Field to witness the long-awaited moment…

items.t: Hillsborough deputies are investigating a deadly shooting in Tampa
items.x: Detectives believe the shooting was an isolated incident and said there is no known threat to the public at this time.

items.t: HCSO investigating shooting that left a man dead
items.x: Hillsborough County deputies were investigating a shooting Tuesday night that left a man dead, authorities said.

items.t: Tampa Bay rallies in Game 4 to beat Milwaukee and prevent World Series sweep
items.x: The Tampa Bay Rays staged a dramatic comeback against the Milwaukee Brewers in Game 4 of the World Series, avoiding a sweep and forcing Game 5.

items.t: World Series Game 4: Rays walk it off in extras, keep season alive
items.x: The Tampa Bay Rays kept their World Series hopes alive Tuesday night, defeating the Milwaukee Brewers in a walk-off Game 4 win in extra innings at Tropicana Field.

items.t: 'The internet used to be fun': Firefox reunites 2000s meme stars for anti-AI ad
items.x: Firefox gathered stars of some of the biggest memes of the 2000s for an ad aimed at swaying internet users away from bigger tech companies.

items.t: Rays fans wager thousands on Game 4 as local World Series betting increases
items.x: Tampa Bay Rays fans are betting big on their team during the World Series, with local wagers increasing notably compared to last year, according to Hard Rock Bet.
